self_assessment: Deleted CacheUnaryInterceptor + its wiring in internal/cmd/grpc.go and moved flag caching into the storage/cache decorator (s:f:<ns>:<key>, protobuf) with invalidation on Update/DeleteFlag and Create/Update/DeleteVariant, plus setJSON/getJSON/setProtobuf/getProtobuf helpers; evaluation-response caching (ev1/ev2 keys) is dropped rather than relocated since it is not a storage operation, and Store still satisfies storage.Store by embedding rather than 40 hand-written delegations. go build ./... clean, gofmt/go vet clean, focused packages green, and the only ./internal/... failures (redis, gitfs) are identical at base.
